observations: Many blue plastic/HDPE-looking drums with screw caps/lids and metal/bolt fittings on top.
Drums are stacked closely in bulk; no labels or contents visible.
Some lids show wear/scuffs; one photo shows a few lids with visible dirt/marks.
No readable brand/model, no size markings, and no tap/spigot details visible.

identity.kind: plastic storage drums (bulk, lidded, for liquids)

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show generic lidded plastic drums but do not show material grade (HDPE/PP), chemical compatibility, prior contents, or any certification.

risks.risk: Unknown drum capacity/size (price depends heavily on whether they are small jerrycan-size, 50L, 100L, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo of a measuring tape next to one drum OR a clear shot of any printed size marking/label on the drum body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the smallest common size for liquid drums (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Unknown material grade and chemical compatibility ("any kind of liquid" may be false).
risks.proof: A photo of the drum material marking (e.g., HDPE/PP code) or any spec sheet/certification from the seller.
risks.if_unproven: Priced for general-purpose use only (not guaranteed for aggressive chemicals).

risks.risk: Leak risk / seal condition (lids, gaskets, and closures may be worn).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lid/closure area plus a simple water-fill test video or confirmation that gaskets are intact.

risks.risk: Prior contents contamination (drums may have held chemicals/oil/food; affects usability and resale value).
risks.proof: Photos of any residue/inner wall condition and any history/labeling of what they previously stored.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially contaminated/needs thorough cleaning.

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (bulk price depends on exact count).
risks.proof: A count confirmation or a photo showing a marked grid/total number of drums.
risks.if_unproven: Priced per drum at the worst-case assumption of smaller quantity.

proof_requests: Clear photo showing the drum size/capacity marking (or a tape measure beside one drum).
Close-up of the lid/closure and any gasket/seal area (front and underside).
Photo of any material code/marking on the drum (HDPE/PP etc.).
Photo(s) of the inside of at least one drum (residue/condition).
Confirm the exact number of drums available.
response.reason: The photos confirm lidded plastic liquid drums in bulk, but key pricing drivers (capacity/size, material grade, seal condition, and prior contents) are not readable or verifiable from the images, so a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently yet.
